inherited_findings.notes: finishChildSession closes gate/input then calls endManagedGameKeepingStream(true); successful allowance end settles neutral retained stream. Bridge enforcement explicitly owns only game process. Gateway finishes from Bridge process cleanup confirmation.

Full-quit provider verification uses four-argument connect, which supplies childSession=false; snapshot then reads parent-only provider health. Game-only stop correctly supplies isChildSession; permission expansion is not an acceptable fix.
Provider stop and Sunshine polling precede finishWholeSessionTermination local stop. Failure may enterHome to restore retained stream; success completion precedes stopConnection completion.
Absent preference reads BuildConfig.DEBUG ? 5 : 0. Explicit values are retained. No policy authorizes choosing 5 for release; D01 pending.

Game owns NvConnection/decoder/input/audio and onDestroy stops owned retained connection, marks reconnect and writes resume material. Facade keeps WeakReference<Controller>; it does not keep physical transport alive across owner destruction.

retainedMatches requires catalog game agreement and gates retainedLive. Activity hostStatus directly rereads retained/warmup facts while consoleHostState projects snapshot/host controller; mismatched game observations can suppress transport truth.

Although preflight has ordered named stages, its production Network adapter invokes HostReadiness, whose ONLINE + streaming-port gate runs before Gateway profile/session ensure. Per-profile streamer startup may depend on that sign-in.
null session, allowed manual-sign-in failures and noncancelled timeout return null; caller interprets null as continuation. Only OTHER_PROFILE_ACTIVE is excluded by allowsManualSignIn.

Flags clear before asynchronous conn.stop. A second stop callback takes flags-false branch and completes immediately, and whole-quit upper completion fires before native stop. Existing retained facade callbacks do not characterize actual native stop completion.

Health/current/readiness are separate HTTP observations assembled into one Snapshot without shared producer boot/revision. applySnapshot uses local runEpoch and mixes gameId/process/window readiness; a local epoch is not host atomicity.

LoadingView chains two postOnAnimation callbacks and silently omits action after stop/detach/invisibility; terminal provider work depends on it. StreamHomeActivity API29+ registers frame commit, but older API uses same animation fallback. No physical frame proof performed.
